Navigate to Website → Configuration → Website menu, and enable the Share option on the product page

First, enable the Share option, then select from various social media platforms to allow product sharing.

The sharing options configured in Website Settings can be displayed, allowing you to easily share products on social media platforms with a single click.

For example, clicking on WhatsApp will open a popup window.

Enable the dynamic sharing option to allow users to share content across various platforms with ease.

  • Initial Release.

What does Odoo Website Product Share On Social Media do?

  • It allows you to share website products on social media platforms with one click, using configurable sharing options.

Which social media platforms are supported?

  • It supports popular platforms like Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and more, with dynamic sharing options.

How do I enable social media sharing?

  • You can configure sharing options directly from the Website Settings in Odoo.

Will shared posts include product details?

  • Yes, shared posts will display product titles, descriptions, and images for better engagement.

Can users share products on multiple platforms simultaneously?

  • The dynamic sharing feature allows users to share content across various platforms easily.

How can I add social sharing buttons to product pages?

  • Social sharing buttons can be easily added to product pages through Website Settings.
